_documentation.purpose: Task config for the Migration Delivery Plan + Draft Book-of-Work flow. Persona is product-manager; the task consumes Migration Discovery Context + current/target architecture inputs and emits a hierarchical Initiative -> Epic -> Feature -> Story draft.
_documentation.contextNeeds: mission, product-summary, migration-discovery-context (Q-12 resolver reused verbatim), meta-model-summary, existing-roadmap, target-state-decisions-context (Spec 2026-05-25 PM Tasks Captured Decisions Integration -- decisions are facts the Book of Work must align with), target-tech-stack-context (Spec 2026-05-25 Tech-Stack.md Pre-fill + Target-Tech-Stack.md Write -- rendered target tech stack the Book of Work must honour).
_documentation.responseSchema: GeneratedMigrationBookOfWork — defined and validated in gateway/src/services/generatedMigrationBookOfWorkSchema.ts. The 14-value workstream enum INCLUDES the `unknown` sentinel (Q-7).
_documentation.promptRules: Functional equivalence is mandatory and never asked of the user. No fabrication: every item must trace back to provided inputs. Output is a book of work (backlog), NOT a migration plan document.
_documentation.designPointRefs: Q-1 gateway-only orchestration; Q-3 gateway -> AMS direct REST (no MCP); Q-7 14-value workstream incl. unknown sentinel; Q-11 task config filename; Q-12 reuse Migration Discovery Context resolver verbatim; Q-13 prompt filename; Q-17 auth gating matches product-manager--backlog verbatim.

description: Consumes Migration Discovery Context plus current/target architecture inputs and produces a hierarchical draft book of work (Initiatives -> Epics -> Features -> Stories) with per-item confidence, readiness, traceability, and quality assessment. Generation is gateway-orchestrated; AMS persists only. Functional equivalence is mandatory; sparse context yields prerequisite / refinement stories rather than invented detail.

generationInputs.description: Snapshot of inputs used (Product Definition refs, architecture refs, mapping refs, finding refs, options).

generationSummary.description: Counts + coverage stats produced by the generator (initiative/epic/feature/story counts, confidence breakdown, readiness breakdown, findings addressed/not addressed, coverage).

qualityAssessment.description: Whole-book + per-level rubric scores with rationale.

items.description: Flat array of MigrationBookOfWorkItem records (parentId references form the hierarchy). Each item carries id, type (initiative|epic|feature|story), parentId|null, title, description, acceptanceCriteria[], workstream (14-value enum incl. unknown), sequenceOrder, tags[], confidence (high|medium|low), readiness (ready_for_spec|needs_focused_context|needs_user_decision|blocked), readinessReasons[], missingInputs[], recommendedNextAction, traceabilitySummary, and reference arrays (evidenceReferences[], architectureReferences[], apiBaselineReferences[], discoveryFindingReferences[], mappingReferences[], sourceContextRefs[]).

artifacts.description: Generated hierarchical migration book of work (draft) with per-item confidence, readiness, traceability, and quality assessment. Persisted to architecture-model-service `generated_migration_books_of_work` table; the optional AMS `/generate` endpoint is intentionally NOT used (gateway is the sole orchestrator).
